purpose: Paired input-representation diagnostic of immediate move facts; no move choice, commentary, training, model selection or strength claim

source.rights: Retained Lichess puzzle database prefix, CC0 declared by upstream; reused source, not new acquisition

selection.bucket: sha256(str(seed)+":"+game_id) integer modulo10 must equal1 (development only)
selection.order: First16 eligible distinct games/boards in exact CSV source order; no sorting or outcome-based balancing
selection.exclusions: Every historical seed and v1/v2/v3/v4 game plus source-before/setup-after board keys for every prior selected puzzle; new before/after board roles disjoint too
selection.position: Replay ONLY first source puzzle setup move to obtain pre-move FEN; source answer tails/annotations are never model inputs
selection.selected_move: Sort legal UCI strings lexicographically; index=int(sha256(str(seed)+":"+game_id),16) modulo legal_move_count. Do not use Stockfish/teacher/annotated bestmove
selection.special_move_coverage: Report actual selected capture/check/castle/en-passant/promotion counts; never replace cases to improve coverage

model.identity: Capture fresh /api/version,/api/tags,/api/show before generation; reject changed digest/family or missing alias. Preserve raw metadata, template/parameters and source hashes. Alias is not architecture/version evidence.

fen_uci_piece_map: 64-square map of pre-move piece symbols or null empty squares
inputs.map_definition: Every a1..h8 square maps to the original board piece symbol or null; uppercase White/lowercase Black; no moved-square or capture/check hints
inputs.case_id: Bookkeeping only; not inserted in prompt

facts.moving_colour: Colour of moving piece before move
facts.captured_piece: Captured original piece type; null for no capture
facts.gives_check: Opponent in check immediately after selected move
facts.promotion_piece: Promoted piece name or null for no promotion
facts.abstention: String unknown permitted per field; null is a known no-capture/no-promotion claim, not abstention

prompt.packet: Compact sorted-key JSON containing only the allowed representation; no conversation/context reuse

backend.order: Case indices0..15, paired calls; even case fen_uci then map, odd case map then fen_uci.8cases per condition first.
backend.calls: Exactly one attempted generation per planned case/condition, no retry or repair prompt.32 planned outcomes.
backend.failure: Transport/HTTP/backend-envelope failure stops all later generation requests as not_run_after_backend_failure; parse/truncation failures retain that case and continue. Keep every planned row in denominator.
backend.unload: Finally send empty /api/generate with model and keep_alive0 once; retain unload success/failure without overwriting generation failures
backend.no_replay: Refuse existing generation-attempt marker even after interruption; preserve raw/partial bytes

evaluator.labels: Separate evaluator-only file; never opened by generation. Generate all raw outputs/failures, save and hash seal first; separate evaluator verifies every raw/source binding before reading labels.
evaluator.expected_facts: python-chess move predicates; independently verified by separate board-push/material-difference/king-attack/geometry route and manually specified finite special-move fixtures
evaluator.parse: One complete JSON object only; exactly8keys, no duplicates/extras, no fences/prose/nonfinite constants, strict ordinary Boolean/categorical types. No text repair or later-object rescue.
evaluator.completed: Backend done exactlytrue and done_reason=stop, valid schema. done_reason=length is truncation; missing/other completion state is incomplete/backend failure.
evaluator.primary: All8 facts correct with no unknown and completed strict response, out of full16 per condition. No credit for failed/truncated/unknown cases.
evaluator.field_metrics: For each field exact correct count out of all16 plus explicit unknown counts; malformed/truncated/incomplete/not-run responses receive zero correctness for every field. No partial field recovery from malformed object.
evaluator.case_comparison: Paired descriptive counts only; no significance/generalization/strength/weight-learning conclusion

resources.actual_calls_require: Parent source/test/data review GO and available GPU

retention: All source snapshots and meaningful test result hashes
All32 outcome rows, exact requests/prompt hashes and raw HTTP response bodies
Complete response/thinking/backend timing/eval-count/done-reason metadata where returned
Raw-result seal before separate evaluator-label read; preserve interrupted attempts
limits: 16convenience positions from a reused puzzle prefix; not a representative or accepted commentary benchmark
No strategic rationale, teaching/commentary quality, broad understanding, Elo or sports-transfer claim
Same installed quantized weights in both conditions; representation comparison only
Special moves may be absent; report observed coverage
Unknown upstream pretraining overlap and backend nondeterminism remain
Codex-assisted source and evaluation; practical review does not satisfy formal project promotion gates

primary_sources.supports: Schema format, response and done/timing fields, think option, keep_alive unload behavior
Local JSON-schema output and temperature0; application still validates response strictly
Legal moves, is_capture/is_castling/is_en_passant/gives_check; validate board before use
